## Why Fornax

Client work arrives everywhere, and keeping track of it is a second job. An SIP change in one partner's inbox, a KYC document on WhatsApp, a redemption request on a website form: someone has to read each one, work out what it needs, decide who handles it, chase what's missing and check it got done. Most firms run that on forwarded emails, spreadsheets and memory.

- Requests get missed: one message holds two asks, and only one gets done.
- Nobody's sure who owns it: work sits between people until the client follows up.
- Your best people do data entry: hours go on reading messages, copying folio and PAN details and creating tasks by hand.
- The follow-up falls apart: a missing document, a client who replies days later, a colleague who forgot.

## See it work

Fornax works with mutual fund distributors today. The site's demo shows the messages their teams get every day: personal data is masked, the request is recognised with a confidence score (unsure messages go to a person to sort), and a task is created with the client's details, an owner and a suggested next step. Fornax prepares; the team decides.

## How it works: AI does the legwork, your team makes the calls

- Fornax does it: reads every message on email, WhatsApp and web forms; masks personal data before any AI sees it; splits one message into separate requests; fills in the details and matches the client record; links a client's follow-up to the same request.
- Fornax prepares it for your approval: replies to clients, sent only after a person approves; questions to the client for missing details; its best guess on anything it isn't sure about, for a person to confirm.
- Fornax helps you track it: an owner, a status and a due date on every request; holds and reminders; notes, files and steps on each task; what's pending, late or waiting across the team.

Channel status: Gmail and web forms are live; WhatsApp Business is rolling out with the distributors Fornax works with.

## Who it's for

Fornax is live with mutual fund distribution teams in India. It works best where several people serve many clients, with handoffs, documents or approvals along the way.

1. Mutual fund distributors and wealth advisors (live now, as Sugamkar): SIP changes, redemptions and switches captured with folio details; KYC, nominee and address updates tracked to completion; statement and capital gains requests sent on time; complaints flagged high priority and handled first.
2. Other client-service firms (early access): insurance brokers (quotes, renewals, claims and endorsements), CA and tax firms (filings, tax notices and document collection), law firms (new matters, hearing updates and document requests), and other firms that run on client requests.

## Your team, your routing, your approvals

- Assignment rules: send each kind of request to a person or a team, and let a team take turns. Proposed assignments wait for a manager to confirm.
- Reassign in one click: the new owner sees the original message, details and history.
- Approvals in context: ask a colleague to review or approve before work moves on, with the client's message and the task's history beside them.
- Your request types: start from the mutual fund playbook and add your own kinds of request.

## Built for trust

- Your clients' data stays yours: PAN, Aadhaar, account and folio numbers and contact details are masked before any AI sees a message, and shown only inside the firm's workspace.
- You approve what goes out: when Fornax isn't sure, it asks instead of guessing. Nothing reaches a client without a person's approval.
- Every step on the record: each action and decision is logged and searchable.
- Summaries, not advice: Fornax reports what the client asked for and never recommends products.

## FAQ

### What is Fornax?

Fornax is AI-first work management for client-service teams. Your clients send requests by email, WhatsApp and web forms; Fornax turns each one into an assigned, tracked task and keeps the follow-up moving, with your team approving anything that matters. We work with mutual fund distributors today.

### What is Sugamkar?

Sugamkar is Fornax for mutual fund distributors and wealth advisors: the same platform with a ready-made playbook for SIP changes, redemptions and switches, KYC and nominee updates, statements and complaints.

### How is this different from a shared inbox like Front or Hiver?

A shared inbox helps you manage conversations. Fornax manages the work inside them: it splits a message into separate requests, fills in the details, gives each one an owner and a due date, and tracks it until it's done, even when the client follows up later.

### We already use distributor software or a task tool. Why add Fornax?

Keep them. Those tools are good at client records, transactions and projects, but someone still has to read every incoming message and type the work in by hand. Fornax does that part, so your team starts from a filled-in task.

### Which channels do you work with?

Gmail and web forms are live today. WhatsApp Business is rolling out with the distributors we work with. Every channel lands on the same list.

### What kinds of requests can it handle?

Today Fornax comes with a playbook for mutual fund distributors: SIP changes, redemptions and switches, KYC, nominee and address updates, statement and capital gains requests, and complaints. You can add your own kinds of request. Insurance brokers, CA and tax firms and law firms can talk to us about early access.

### What happens to my clients' personal data?

Personally identifiable information (PII) and sensitive personal information (SPI) are detected in every message and replaced with placeholders before any AI processing. That covers identifiers such as government ID and tax numbers, financial account numbers, phone numbers and email addresses. The originals are restored only inside your workspace.

### Will it reply to my clients on its own?

No. Fornax can prepare a reply or a question for the client, but a person approves it before it goes.

### What if it gets a message wrong?

When Fornax isn't confident, it puts the message on your list and asks you to choose. One click files it correctly, starts the right follow-up, and Fornax learns from your choice for next time.

### Can I decide who gets the work and who approves it?

Yes. You decide which kinds of request go to which person or team, including taking turns across a team, and who reviews or approves work before it moves on. No code required.

### Do I need to change how my team works?

No. Clients keep writing to the same inbox and number, and there is no new app for them. Your team opens one list each morning instead of searching through mail and chats.

### How much does it cost?

We start with a paid pilot covering an agreed set of channels and request types, with clear success measures. Ongoing pricing is a workspace subscription. Talk to us for details.

### How do I get started?

Book a demo. We'll look at a week of your real client requests, agree what Fornax will handle, and connect your first channel with you. Or email sales@fornaxlabs.xyz; we reply within one business day.
